count_planning.comparison_scope: Same 16 key-disjoint constructed targets; three seeds per budget; exact methods evaluated once per target and reused only as references.

dense_prefix_diagnostic.scope: Post-review exploratory diagnostic; same 16 targets, three seeds, budget500/side; all N+1 degree prefixes. Original raw has no study source_id.
dense_prefix_diagnostic.preserved_exception: One shared uncovered audit; dense and coarse genuinely freeze and retain final support None. All observed losses remain below .1.
dense_prefix_diagnostic.timing_scope: Separate local elapsed timings, not co-timed or live latency.

structural.fixture: Synthetic fixed labels; all helper scores .5; 1 input and 1 output synthetic token per oracle/helper request. Prices are sensitivity parameters, not estimated inference charges.

error_bars.count: ECDF of all fixed paired cells; no statistical interval.
error_bars.mechanisms: Pooled deterministic request differences; no error bar.
error_bars.structural: Arithmetic means over 18 K/law/seed targets; no error bar.
error_bars.native: Min/max complete oracle requests over the six fixed budget/seed settings (125 or 500; seeds 101,202,303). Points are their arithmetic means; ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.

native.error_bar_meaning: Min/max complete oracle requests over the six fixed budget/seed settings (125 or 500; seeds 101,202,303). Points are their arithmetic means; ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
native.cost_scope: Oracle calls include all cut, audit, and execution calls. Helper tokens are additionally charged in token sensitivity. Exact methods have zero loss; approximate methods have allowance .1 relative to immutable model tape.
